name: nodes
label: Node items
description: Node items to draw on the map

name: edges
label: Edge items
description: Edge items, which describe connections between pairs of nodes

name: nodeMacroponent
label: Node view macroponent
description: A node can be an existing component or a custom UI builder page.

name: clusterMacroponent
label: Cluster node view component
description: A cluster node can be an existing component or a custom UI builder page.

name: nodeShape
label: Node shape
description: Describes the shape of the nodes. Used for the edges layout calculation.

name: layout
label: Map layout
description: Available layouts for nodes and edges.

name: edgeType
label: Edges type
description: The shape of the edges. Different layouts support different edge types, this property only effective if layout support the selected edge type.

name: nodeWidthMode
label: Width
description: Calculation method for the width of all nodes.

name: nodeHeightMode
label: Height
description: Calculation method for the height of all nodes.

name: nodeWidth
label: Node width
description: The fixed width for all nodes, defined in pixels.

name: nodeHeight
label: Node height
description: The fixed height for all nodes, defined in pixels.

name: maxNodeWidth
label: Max node width
description: The maximum width for all nodes, defined in pixels.

name: maxNodeHeight
label: Max node height
description: The maximum height for all nodes, defined in pixels.

name: nodeSize
label: Default size
description: The default size for all nodes.  Can be overridden in the node configuration.

name: nodeSpacing
label: Node spacing
description: Increase or decrease the space between nodes. default 250

name: reduceNodeSpacing
label: Reduce spacing between nodes
description: Reduce vertical/horizontal space between nodes

name: disableMapContextMenu
label: Disable map context menu
description: Turns off the map context menu and the related event

name: suspendReLayout
label: Suspend re-layout
description: Suspend re-layout, In order to prevent the elements from reposition during adding new data.

name: selectionMode
label: Selection mode
description: Sets the map selection mode only available when manageElementSelection is set to false

name: disableNodesContextMenu
label: Disable nodes context menu
description: Turns off the nodes context menu and the related event

name: disableEdgesContextMenu
label: Disable edges context menu
description: Turns off the edges context menu and the related event

name: contextualActions
label: Contextual menu items
description: Array of DropdownItems to present in the contextual menu

name: mapContextualActions
label: Map contextual menu items
description: Array of DropdownItems to present in the map contextual menu

name: controlPanelButtons
label: Control panel buttons
defaultValue: [{"id": "btnZoomIn","tooltipContent":"Zoom in","icon": "plus-outline", "behavior" :"zoom-in"},{"id": "btnZoomOut","tooltipContent":"Zoom out","icon": "minus-outline", "behavior" :"zoom-out"},{"id": "btnAlignToHomeNode","tooltipContent":"Align to home node","icon": "home-outline", "separator" :true, "behavior":"align-home-node"},{"id": "btnFitToScreen","tooltipContent":"Fit to screen","icon": "collapse-outline", "behavior":"fit-to-screen"},{"id": "btnExportMap","tooltipContent":"Export map","icon": "circle-download-outline", "behavior":"choice","choices": [{"id": "btnExportPDF","label": "PDF","icon": "document-pdf-outline","sublabel": "Export to PDF","behavior": "export"},{"id": "btnExportImage","label": "Image","icon": "document-image-outline","sublabel": "Export to Image","behavior": "export-image"}]},{"id": "btnCollapseAll","tooltipContent":"Collapse all","icon": "sync-outline", "behavior":"collapse-all"},{"id": "btnLayoutUnifiedVertical","tooltipContent":"Switch to unified vertical layout","icon": "tree-outline", "separator" :true, "behavior": "change-layout-vertical"},{"id": "btnLayoutUnifiedForce","tooltipContent":"Switch to unified force layout","icon": "combine-outline", "behavior":"change-layout-force"}]
description: Array of buttons to present in the control panel

name: disableExpand
label: Disable expand
description: Hides the 'expand' and 'collapse' buttons on all nodes.

name: disableHiddenConnections
label: Disable 'show hidden connections'
description: Hides the 'show hidden connections' button on all nodes.

name: disableHome
label: Disable 'home'
description: Hides the 'home' button on all nodes.

name: disableMinimap
label: Disable minimap
description: Removes the minimap view and functionality.

name: hideEdgeArrows
label: Hide edge arrows
description: Displays all edges as non-directional, without arrows.

name: mergePortsThreshold
label: Merged edge ports threshold
description: Minimal number of edges on one side of a node to begin merging the edge ports. Value 0 turns the merging off. The recommended threshold for the default node is 5.

name: mergeEdgeSegments
label: Merged edge segments
description: Visually merge edge lines for a more compact map view.

name: homeNodeId
label: Home node
description: Sets a node as home.

name: disableAlignHomeNode
label: Disable align home node
description: Disable align to home node feature and remove its button from control panel.

name: disableCollapseAll
label: Disable collapse all
description: Disable collapse all, remove its button from control panel.

name: alignToNodeId
label: Align to node Id
description: Move the viewport around a specific node.

name: alignToNodePosition
label: Node alignment position
description: Determines where on the viewport to display the aligned node. start, end position may change according to layout

name: expandedGroupNodeIds
label: Expanded group nodes

items.title: Id of a group node to consider expanded

description: Expanded group nodes have 'collapse' action on the contextual bar (instead of 'expand' action).

name: hiddenEdgeIds
label: Hidden edges

items.title: Id of an edge to hide

description: Hidden edges participate in the map layout, but are not drawn and are not reachable on the map.

name: hiddenNodeIds
label: Hidden nodes

items.title: Id of a node to hide

description: Hidden nodes participate in the map layout, but are not drawn and are not reachable on the map.

name: inactiveNodeIds
label: Inactive nodes
description: Inactive nodes participate in map layout, but appears as inactive (disabled).

name: inactiveEdgeIds
label: Inactive edges
description: Inactive edges participate in map layout, but appears as inactive (disabled).

name: selectedElementId
label: Selected Element Id
description: (@deprecated use selectedElements) - ID of selected node or edge. This feature is only activated when manageElementSelection property turned on.

name: selectedElements
label: Selected Elements

items.title: element Id edge or node but not both

description: Contains the elements IDs to be auto selected. This feature is only activated when manageElementSelection property turned on.

name: manageElementSelection
label: Manage element selection
description: Enables a programmatic selection of nodes and edges. When this property turned on nodes/edges can only be selected Programmatically using selectedElementId property.

name: fitToScreen
label: Fit to screen
description: Resizes the map to fit into the view port

name: reduceMotion
label: Reduce Motion
description: Reduce component motion by eliminating animation.

name: showHiddenControls
label: Always show hidden controls
description: Some controls may be hidden until the relevant element is hovered or focused. This setting reveals all hidden controls inside the component.

name: enableMagnificationEffect
label: Enable magnification effect
description: Set this property to `true` to show a magnification effect on hovering a node.

name: isLoading
label: Show loading state
description: Turns on the loading spinner

name: loadingMessage
label: Override loading state message
description: Optional message for the loading state.

name: isEmpty
label: Show empty state
description: Enables the empty state placeholder

name: emptyMessage
label: Override empty state message
description: Optional message for the empty state.

name: isError
label: Show error state
description: Turns on the error state banner

name: errorMessage
label: Override error state message
description: Optional message for the error state.

name: disableControlPanel
label: Disable control panel menu
description: Turns off the control panel menu and the related event

name: disableFind
label: Disable find on map
description: When true, hides the find on map input control.

name: disableDragging
label: Disable node dragging
description: When true, disables node dragging functionality.

name: manageFind
label: Manage find result
description: When true, manage the find result. otherwise, the find will be applied to the visual elements on the screen

name: manageAutoGroupEdges
label: Manage auto group edges
description: Enable this property to override the automatic creation of edges between group and its direct children. Edges array must be supplied when enabling this property.

name: manageExpanded
label: Manage expanded groups
description: Enable this property to override the automatic creation of expanded groups.

name: findData
label: Find on map
description: Contains find data related structures.

name: labelPosition
label: Label position
description: The position of the node's labels (primary and secondary) outside that node

name: canLabelScale
label: Label scaling
description: Enables the label scaling supported only in unified layouts and horizontal layout

name: reLayoutRequested
label: Re-layout requested
description: An object containing a timestamp that can be passed down to trigger a map re-layout

name: controlsPosition
label: Controls position
description: An object containing a positioning of minimap, control panel and finder controls

name: popoverConfig
label: Popover config
description: An object containing a popover configuration: type: the type of the popover can be tooltip or popover, contentState: that state of the content, the default is 'empty', 'pending' will show loader and 'ready' will show the popover Macroponent that currently active, hoverConfig:  component: Ref/sys_id of a macro component , hoverProperties the parameters that pass to hover popover Macroponent and elements choices: 'all', 'node' and 'edge' and clickConfig:  component: Ref/sys_id of a macro component , clickProperties the parameters that pass to click popover Macroponent and elements choices: 'all', 'node' and 'edge'

name: edgesAggregation
label: Edges aggregation
description: Define the edges aggregation type
